title: Matrix factorization analyses of the immgenT scRNA-seq data
site: workflowr::wflow_site

---

This site documents the gene program (GP) factorization analysis of the ImmGen-T
single-cell RNA-seq/CITE-seq data: ~200 GPs learned by empirical Bayes matrix
factorization (EBMF), and how they relate to cell lineage, tissue, activation
state, transcription factors, and surface protein expression.

Each page below covers one figure: for every panel, the R code that produced
it, the figure itself, and its caption.

## Main figures

+ [Figure 1: A gene-program architecture underlies T cell heterogeneity across the immgenT atlas](Figure1.html)
+ [Figure 2: Individual T cells deploy sparse combinations of gene programs that expand with activation](Figure2.html)
+ [Figure 3: T cell lineage identity is encoded by both lineage-restricted and shared gene programs](Figure3.html)
+ [Figure 4: Gene programs resolve T cell states below the level of lineage](Figure4.html)
+ [Figure 5: Activated T cell states arise from shared and lineage-biased combinations of gene programs](Figure5.html)
+ [Figure 6: Tissue-associated gene programs reflect both tissue adaptation and T cell subset composition](Figure6.html)
+ [Figure 7: Surface-marker associations are context-dependent, but combinatorial gating resolves specific gene programs](Figure7.html)
+ [Figure 8b: A nonlinear deep-learning framework independently recovers the immgenT gene-program landscape](Figure8.html)

Only panel **b** of Figure 8 is documented here; the RQVI panels are in the
[companion repository for the RQVI framework](https://github.com/TianzeCompbio/RQVI_GP_figures/tree/main).

## Reproducing these figures

Each page is generated by one R script in
[`script/`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/immgenT-GP-analysis/tree/main/script).
From the repository root:

```
Rscript script/Figure1.R
```
